'''Ban-yaro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as the [[communications chief]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Ban-yaro was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] after completing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], Ban-yaro went onto pursue independent study as a [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Sentinel]] specialized in communications. After serving the Order for some time, Ban-yaro was made a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. At some point as a Master, Ban-yaro was appointed to the position of [[communications chief]] at the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]].<ref name="CWGS" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Ban-yaro remained at the Temple to help coordinate [[Jedi command/Legends|Jedi Command]]. When Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were appointed a secret assignment by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], Ban-yaro was advised to keep all that he heard a secret so as not to endanger the pair. As Kenobi and Skywalker sent scrambled transmissions to the Temple, Ban-yaro kept the Grand Master informed of their [[Battle of Lanteeb|mission]] on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. When the Jedi homed in on Confederacy [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] and his deadly [[nanovirus]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] aided Ban-yaro and the Jedi to end the Separatist threat.<ref name="CWGS" />
